title: Dots & Boxes
blurb: Draw lines, close squares, get double-crossed. Play against Amog himself, who has read Berlekamp and will not hesitate.

title: Alchemy
blurb: A skyblock in the void, after SkyFactory 3. One tree, then compost, sieves, furnaces, crucibles and cobblestone generators, all the way to the Philosopher's Stone.

title: Whack-a-Moni
blurb: You are Redstone. Moni keeps surfacing with a banana. Bonk him, build a combo, and under no circumstances bonk Megumin or Shiro.
